title: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
description: Hands-on KillerCoda labs covering all current CKS exam domains.

items.title: Cluster Setup (10%)
items.description: Network Security Policies, CIS Benchmarks, Ingress TLS, node metadata, and platform binary verification

items.title: Cluster Hardening (15%)
items.description: Kubernetes API access, RBAC, service accounts, upgrades, secrets, and security primitives

items.title: System Hardening (15%)
items.description: Host OS footprint, IAM, external access, OS configuration, system logs, and container runtime

items.title: Minimize Microservice Vulnerabilities (20%)
items.description: Namespace isolation, NetworkPolicies, Pod Security Standards, OS security domains, runtime security, audit logging, and pod-to-pod encryption

items.title: Supply Chain Security (20%)
items.description: Base image footprint, supply-chain trust, manifest analysis, and image vulnerability scanning

items.title: Monitoring, Logging and Runtime Security (20%)
items.description: Behavioral analytics, physical infrastructure threats, workload threats, and Kubernetes audit logs
